hero.label: Escape Self-Sabotage · Free Sample
hero.titel: You know what you want. So why are you constantly getting *the exact opposite?*
text: Some decisions are hard to make sense of in hindsight. Especially your own.
What if it's not a weakness at all, but a logic you just haven't cracked yet?
hero.notiz: Maybe not everything is as illogical as it seems …

wiedererkennen.titel: Do you ever feel like you somehow keep ending up *in the same place* where you started?
wiedererkennen.text: The situations change. The people change, too. But somehow, the outcome feels strangely familiar.

karten.label: Finances
karten.text: You work so hard that you should have more than enough left over by now. And yet it feels like you're running on a hamster wheel that just keeps spinning faster. You have to keep pushing harder just to make ends meet. And there's barely anything left for yourself.

karten.label: Relationships
karten.text: Different people. Different stories. Everything seemed different this time. And yet, sooner or later, that familiar feeling creeps back in. Things start slipping out of your control again, and somewhere along the way, you realize you've lost yourself.

karten.label: Body & Wellbeing
karten.text: The decision is made. And you're disciplined. This time, it's finally paying off and you're getting exactly the results you want. Until the progress suddenly stops, and your old patterns take over again, even though you really should have known better by now.

wiedererkennen.abschluss: Why does this keep happening to you?

anmeldung.titel: The first door is *open* for you.
text: Room 1 focuses on the question that starts it all: Why does this keep happening to me?
A first shift in perspective. No ready-made answers, no quick fixes. Rather, it’s the beginning of a truly fascinating search for clues.
anmeldung.hinweis: Signing up gets you access to Room 1 and my newsletter on self-sabotage, pattern recognition, and Identity Upgrade products. You can unsubscribe anytime with one click.
anmeldung.fehler: Please fill in your first name, last name, and email address, choose your biggest struggle, and check your details.
anmeldung.bildNotiz: All you need is a notebook.

haltung.titel: Maybe your behavior was never as *illogical* as you thought.
haltung.text: You can give other people pretty great advice, but somehow, when it comes to yourself, it just doesn't work? And now it gets interesting: looking back, all your decisions can seem completely incomprehensible, not only to others, but above all to yourself. Yet they still made perfect sense within your own world. Spoiler: Only when you begin to see how these things connect can real change happen. Until then, like clockwork, you keep ending up back at square one.

sofunktionierts.titel: Not an ordinary book. An *escape room.*
sofunktionierts.text: One house. Three levels. Countless rooms, and behind every door, a different perspective on what you've taken pretty much for granted until now. This isn't about finding the exit as fast as possible. It's about you asking the right questions and understanding why certain doors keep leading you back to the same place.

stationen.text: From the outside, it looks like any other house. But once you're inside, you realize how little you actually know it.
The elevator connects the levels. But it only comes back for you once you've explored every room on your level.
They take you step by step deeper into the question of why you keep ending up where you don't actually want to be.
Every room revolves around a question. To move on, you have to examine the clues inside.
Small hints, apparent contradictions, and thoughts that suddenly put everything in a different light.

sofunktionierts.notiz: The exit isn't necessarily where you'd expect it to be.

text: That question took me down paths the little girl who was determined to become an opera singer could never even have dreamed of. More than anything, though, those paths kept leading me, with astonishing consistency, straight into devastating setbacks in the areas of my life that mattered most. So I started digging deep into human behavior, perception, external manipulation, and self-sabotage. I trained as a hypnotist, obsessively researched every possible way to improve my life, and spent more than twenty years building up a pretty extensive body of knowledge.
And yet, before long, I was right back in it, up to my neck: another toxic relationship, broke again. Once again, nothing was turning out the way I wanted.

In June 2025, I filled out an enormous questionnaire. As part of a program, my answers were supposed to be analyzed to identify my patterns of self-sabotage. But that never happened, because someone had made sure I was kicked out of the program before we got that far. So I analyzed myself. And what I discovered changed not only how I saw the life I had lived up to that point, but everything that came after.

hero.titel: Why you keep getting what you don’t want — and what you’ve *been overlooking.*
text: Eight rooms. 48 clues that gradually reveal what drives your thoughts, decisions, and behavior.
This isn’t a book you simply read. You become the investigator of your own life — and may begin to see things in a completely different light.
hero.notiz: Maybe it’s time to start asking the right questions.

raeume.t: Why does this keep happening to me?
raeume.x: You promised yourself you’d never do it again. And yet, here you are.
Without knowing the circumstances, almost any decision can look like the wrong one.
A whole new look at decisions you question today.
The hidden rules that guide you, usually without you even noticing.

raeume.t: Who planted that thought in your head?
raeume.x: How do you know that what you’re so sure of is actually true?

raeume.t: Which menu did you choose from?
raeume.x: Who decides what your options are in the first place?

raeume.t: Knowing better doesn’t automatically mean doing better
raeume.x: There’s more between knowing and doing than you think.

raeume.t: The contradictions that give you away
raeume.x: “But that’s not who I am.” That’s exactly where it gets interesting.

haltung.titel: Not every decision you make is truly *your own.*
text: Many of your beliefs were passed down to you long before you were even able to question them. Some rules you still follow today, without really knowing where they came from. Sometimes, you're simply choosing between options someone else has laid out for you. And ultimately, some decisions you make are shaped by the simple fact that, at the time, you can't possibly know what possibilities you're not yet aware of.
Maybe real change doesn't begin with trying to make better decisions. Maybe it begins with understanding how you came to make those decisions in the first place.

privacy.label: The fine print
privacy.kurz: We collect your name and email so we can send you Room 1 and our newsletter. No cookies, no tracking tools, and we *never sell your data.* Here are the details.

p: Identity Upgrade is run by **KlewerINN LLP**, a limited liability partnership based in Canada. Heike Klewer is the author of the books and content you find here. When this page says “we” or “us,” it means KlewerINN LLP. When it says “you,” that's you.
You can reach us anytime at [[EMAIL]].

teile.label: What you give us
teile.p: When you sign up for Room 1, you give us:
liste: your first and last name and your email address
your biggest struggle (finances, relationships, body & wellbeing, or more than one)
your phone number, if you choose to add it. It's optional.

teile.label: What gets recorded automatically
p: This website is hosted on Cloudflare. Like any web server, it briefly processes some technical data so the page can reach you: your IP address, browser and device type, the page you requested, and the time.
We also note where you came from, for example a campaign link or the website that sent you, and save it with your sign-up. That's it. No cookies, no tracking pixels, no analytics tools on this site.

teile.label: What we never see
teile.p: If you buy the e-book, payment is handled entirely by Digistore24. Your card or bank details go straight to them. We never see them.

liste: Send you our newsletter on self-sabotage, pattern recognition, and Identity Upgrade products
Match our emails to your biggest struggle
Use your phone number, if you gave it, only to ask whether you'd like to be contacted by phone or text for other programs. We won't call or text you without your explicit consent.
Answer you when you write to us
Understand which campaigns bring people here

teile.p: That's the whole list. We don't sell, rent, or trade your personal information.
We rely on a few companies to run this. They only get what they need to do their job.
liste: **Cloudflare, Inc.** (USA) hosts and delivers this website
**Kit** (ConvertKit LLC, USA) stores your sign-up and sends our emails. Kit records whether an email was opened and which links were clicked.
**Digistore24 GmbH** (Germany) sells the e-book as a reseller and handles your purchase under its own privacy policy

teile.p: This means your data may be processed in the United States and Canada. We may also share information if the law requires it, or if the business is ever sold or transferred, in which case this policy goes with it.

abschnitte.nav: Email, and how to stop it

p: After you sign up, you'll get one email asking you to confirm your address. You're only added once you click that link.
Every email we send has an unsubscribe link at the bottom. It works immediately and costs you nothing. You can also just reply and ask us to take you off.

You can ask us what we have about you, have it corrected or deleted, and withdraw your consent at any time. Just email [[EMAIL]]. Depending on where you live, privacy laws such as Canada's PIPEDA, the California Consumer Privacy Act, or the EU's GDPR give you these rights specifically, and you can file a complaint with your privacy regulator.
We keep your sign-up data as long as you're subscribed. Once you unsubscribe, we delete it, except for a record of your consent and unsubscribe, which we keep as proof.

teile.p: This site is for adults. It's not directed at anyone under 16, and we don't knowingly collect their information. If you think your child signed up, email us and we'll delete it.
This site only runs over an encrypted connection, and our providers use industry-standard protection. No system is perfect, and we won't pretend ours is.
If we change this policy, the date at the top changes with it. If it's a significant change, we'll let you know by email.

privacy.schluss: We don't sell your information. *Not now, not ever.*
privacy.schlussNotiz: Some things really are that simple.
